content.value_statement: Angular applications can become slow through change detection, bundle growth, and rendering waste. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code focused guidance for safer refactors and reviews.
actual_capabilities: Reviews Angular components for change detection, Signals, and OnPush usage.
Identifies async waterfall patterns and suggests RxJS alternatives.
Guides bundle reduction with lazy routes, dynamic imports, and @defer.
Recommends rendering improvements for lists, templates, pipes, and virtual scrolling.
Explains SSR, hydration, TransferState, and memory cleanup patterns.
limitations: Does not run benchmarks or inspect a live Angular application by itself.
Recommendations still require project-specific testing and code review.
Focuses on Angular and TypeScript, not React, Vue, or backend frameworks.
Examples may need adaptation for older Angular versions.

use_cases.title: Review a Feature Component
use_cases.description: Find performance issues in a component before it reaches production.

use_cases.title: Plan a Performance Refactor
use_cases.description: Prioritize changes across change detection, rendering, data loading, and bundles.

use_cases.title: Guide AI Code Generation
use_cases.description: Keep generated Angular code aligned with modern framework patterns.
use_cases.target_user: Claude, Codex, or Claude Code user

prompt_templates.title: Review One Component
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small Angular component.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Angular component for performance issues. Focus on change detection, Signals, subscriptions, and template work. Return prioritized recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Route
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Angular route and its imports. Suggest lazy loading, @defer usage, and bundle reductions that preserve behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Data Loading
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of RxJS and SSR data flow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Angular data loading flow. Identify waterfalls, duplicate requests, SSR hydration problems, and safer RxJS patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Create Refactor Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a staged Angular performance refactor plan for this feature. Rank changes by impact, risk, and validation steps.

output_examples.input: A dashboard component uses default change detection and several mutable fields.
output: Highest impact: switch the component to OnPush and move reactive state to Signals.
Medium impact: replace repeated template calculations with computed values or pure pipes.
Validation: compare render counts and interaction latency before and after the refactor.

output_examples.input: A profile page fetches profile data after the client component initializes.
output: Use a resolver or server-side preload for critical profile data.
Use TransferState to prevent duplicate browser requests after hydration.
Keep non-critical widgets deferred until viewport or interaction.

output_examples.input: A feature imports charts, tables, and admin views in the main route.
output: Lazy load admin routes and large feature views.
Load heavy chart libraries only when the chart is needed.
Measure the initial bundle after each change to confirm the reduction.

best_practices: Ask for the Angular version before applying version-specific recommendations.
Validate each recommendation with tests, profiling, or bundle analysis.
Apply the highest impact changes before small template cleanups.
anti_patterns: Treating every example as a required rewrite without measuring impact.
Changing data flow and rendering strategy in one unreviewed patch.
Applying SSR guidance to client-only applications without checking requirements.

faq.question: Does this skill execute Angular code?
faq.answer: No. It provides review guidance and examples for Angular performance work.

faq.question: Can it replace performance profiling?
faq.answer: No. Use it to guide reviews, then confirm results with profiling and bundle tools.

faq.question: Which Angular topics does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers OnPush, Signals, Zoneless, RxJS loading, lazy bundles, rendering, SSR, hydration, and cleanup.

faq.question: Is it useful for legacy Angular projects?
faq.answer: Yes, but modern patterns may require version checks and staged migration.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use it during refactors?
faq.answer: Yes. It helps AI coding tools prioritize Angular performance changes and review generated code.

faq.question: Does it cover application security?
faq.answer: Only indirectly. Its main focus is frontend performance and Angular code quality.
